frozen_before: first successful multi-layer bind; stacks-probe-01/02/03 all have zero events
identity: Every native frame in target and both controls <= own null maximum MAD + 0.05, including bind/restore edges.
positive_each_band: Each event median MAD from baseline >= max(4.0, 4*max(null_band_max, 0.5)); median vertical adjacent-pixel absolute difference <= 0.75 * baseline vertical adjacent-pixel absolute difference.
correct_blur_edges: Use each event's middle image as the blurred reference. In every band, accept the intended blurred state only if its MAD from that reference <= max(null_band_max, stable_blur_window_max)+0.05, and baseline MAD exceeds the positive limit. Stable blur window is the middle five frames. Search surrounding frames using pixels; start/end must exactly equal labelled start/end. This additionally rejects initial fallback/black frames that differ from both intended states.
controls_and_restore: All unlabelled target frames after the null and all control frames stay within own null maximum+0.05; retain existing explicitly reported PIE end-settle exclusions only for teardown.
inherited: E1 t50 zero unflagged; annotation==labels; no labelled frame without independently measured target-only mask; can-fail partial-layer, early-bind and no-bind; no threshold retuning after a valid positive.
